headline: Alexey Kulikov: Illicit tobacco is an enforcement issue, and lower taxes would cheapen all tobacco
dek: Writing on X, the WHO technical officer said investment cases should account for illicit trade, but argued that lower tobacco taxes would make all tobacco cheaper.
body:
Dr Alexey Kulikov wrote on X on 14 November 2026 in reply to another user, responding to a point about investment cases and illicit tobacco trade. His profile describes him as a Technical Officer in the WHO Department of NCDs and mental health and as part of the Secretariat of the UN NCD Task Force.

Kulikov said it was a "fair point" that investment cases should account for illicit trade, but added that "the health test matters too". He cited Australian figures attributed to the AIHW, saying daily smoking in the country fell to 5.6% in 2025, down from 8.3% two years earlier.

He described illicit supply as an enforcement problem and argued that lower taxes would make all tobacco cheaper.
key_quote: Illicit supply is an enforcement problem.
